answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the walnut hash is stored at intake, the nadir graph groups the endorsements and the dawn audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 28 aliases hence pays for 28 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
